title: 2021-22 Panini Donruss #52 Al Horford Boston Celtics Basketball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2021-22 Panini Donruss trading card featuring Al Horford of the Boston Celtics. This basketball card is part of the base set for the National Basketball Association (NBA) league. Manufactured by Panini, the card number is 52, making it a valuable collector's item for fans of the sport and the player.
